prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one finished portrait sourceArt illustration for an SSS Limited mercenary in the Soopketmon PROJECT V collectible RPG.
Primary request: Redraw Image 1 with as close to 100% fidelity to its character design, composition, pose, sword, garments, dragon design, aura paths and background arrangement as possible. Change ONLY its rendering language to the project's polished 2D semi-realistic fantasy game illustration style. This is a faithful style translation, not a character redesign.

Input roles:
Image 1 is the absolute design/composition/identity reference and edit target: the long black-haired adult male Eastern swordsman in white, charcoal and gold, surrounded by a large golden Eastern dragon aura.
Image 2 (the red-clad female mercenary Vespera) is the PRIMARY PAINTING STYLE reference ONLY: clean expressive 2D game face, controlled painterly shading, luminous material separation, sophisticated splash-art finish. Do NOT borrow her face, anatomy, hair, costume, weapon, colors or environment.
Image 3 (the blue-clad male mercenary) is a supporting MALE DRAWING STYLE reference ONLY: refined 2D facial painting and clean skin shading. Do NOT borrow his facial identity, short haircut, seated pose, costume, sword or blue palette.

LOCK TO IMAGE 1:
- Match its exact vertical 2:3 framing and camera distance. Keep the same nearly full-length standing silhouette centered slightly right, crown near upper sixth, long robes reaching the lower edge, three-quarter head turned toward screen right. Do not zoom into a bust, change the pose, mirror the image or invent another composition.
- Preserve the adult male's facial structure, calm majestic expression, nose/lips/eye shape, fair skin, long black half-tied hair, sweeping loose lengths toward screen left and fine face-framing strands. Repaint those same features in a handsome polished 2D RPG face, without replacing him with either style-reference person.
- Preserve the asymmetrical black/white open-chested embroidered robes exactly: deep V open ivory silk exposing chest and abdomen, fitted charcoal-black armored sleeve and sculpted dark-gold dragon-scale pauldron on SCREEN LEFT, wide flowing ivory sleeve on SCREEN RIGHT, dark inner robe layers, embroidered lapels and skirt, ornate dragon-faced golden waist clasp and fine hanging gold chains. Keep all major garment panels, trims, silhouette and original ornament density.
- Match hand positions: SCREEN LEFT arm hangs low gripping the sword at the hip; SCREEN RIGHT arm extends out with relaxed open palm turned upward directly below the dragon's muzzle. Five anatomically natural fingers per hand with correct grasp and wrist connections.
- Sword fidelity is critical: same black wrapped grip angling up-left from the lowered hand, ornate dark-gold dragon sculpted guard, long narrow straight double-edged blade sweeping diagonally down-right across the lower image, warm golden edges and fine flowing fire-like energy around it. Keep hilt, guard and blade connected on a single coherent rigid axis. Do not replace with a greatsword, katana, spear or short sword. Preserve its original scale, shape, ornament and lower-right exit.
- GOLDEN DRAGON AURA IS MANDATORY AND A MAJOR SUBJECT. Preserve the same single enormous wingless Eastern serpentine dragon winding around the figure in the original front/back layered loops. Its large fierce head is on the UPPER RIGHT just above the open palm; retain the swept antler horns, pointed brow, long whiskers, flared cheek/jaw spikes, pointed snout, luminous amber eyes, fanged partially open jaws, detailed gold-bronze scales and flame-edged mane. Preserve the original head silhouette and design, not a generic dragon. Its substantial scaled coils continue behind the torso and along the right side; brilliant translucent golden aura curls around the left shoulder, across the lower foreground and around the hem. Keep the same sweeping golden arcs, thickness, spatial layering and aura coverage as Image 1. It must read as a tangible detailed dragon spirit with luminous scales, not merely smoke, a ribbon, a flat emblem or a small pet.
- Same dark charcoal garden background with softly painted warm pale blossoms on gnarled branches in the upper left and behind the head, understated rocks/ground near the hem. Preserve warm gold/ivory/black palette and overall lighting/mood; no new temple, moon, throne, city or secondary characters.

Rendering change:
High-end character-centric semi-realistic fantasy splash art, sophisticated Korean/Japanese collectible RPG 2D illustration. Clearly hand-painted/stylized game artwork rather than photorealistic movie or 3D CGI. Elegant precise facial line accents, soft clean shaded skin, painterly hair/cloth/metal, intricate but controlled edges, atmospheric background integration. Hair must flow organically from roots to ends with soft continuous volumes and fine individual flyaways; NO layered plates, ribbon-like chunks, stair-stepped silhouette or plastic highlights. Preserve the original long hair design. Golden dragon aura lights the hair, metal, exposed skin and silk consistently. The face and dragon head remain clearly readable against dark values while matching the source composition.
One complete image, native exact 2:3 portrait, at least 1024 x 1536 pixels (2048 x 3072 preferred if supported), full background, opaque RGB appearance.
No text, rank letters, names, logos, watermark, signatures, card border, frame, panels or UI. No extra props, no extra limbs, no new weapon, no wings, no western dragon. No arbitrary redesign or simplification. The user specifically wants Image 1 almost identically designed and composed, with ONLY the project's drawing/painting style substituted.
